outcome: Symphony Forge delegations now run end-to-end on native Windows: forge delegate launches, supervises, and reaps Codex workers through a single psutil-based process model (decision 0042) on both Windows and POSIX — retiring the ps/killpg machinery and its lstart fragility. psutil ships as the harness's first runtime Python dependency, gated by a required doctor row and installed by doctor --fix (venv-aware, PEP-668-honest, converges in one run). Windows workers record the workspace-write sandbox; the unelevated tightening stays deferred (D-0021). The windows-hook-gates CI selector gains a real Windows launch/reap E2E.
